text:
noah: quick flag  onboarding demo used the org key after a project-key rotation. Repro and logs below.

noah: repro: set RW_API_KEY_PROJECT, start demo, rotate project key in console -> subsequent calls used REDWOOD_API_KEY (org).

anya: saw similar. SDK auth-loader now returns REDWOOD_API_KEY when both exist during a hot-reload. Log: auth.loader picked=REDWOOD_API_KEY (org) even though RW_API_KEY_PROJECT present.

devon: minimal repro snippet:```bash
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=org-aaaabbbb
export RW_API_KEY_PROJECT=proj-xyz123
node examples/onboard.js
# after rotation requests are authorized with org-aaaabbbb
```

sam: related: streaming clients (WS/SSE/long-poll) keep the old header and when rotation happens they get 401 and the SDK closes the stream. Propose: on first 401 call tokenProvider.refresh() if available, swap header, retry the frame/heartbeat once; if still 401 emit `auth.rotation_failed` event for the app to handle.

anya: also propose explicit precedence: RW_API_KEY_PROJECT > RW_API_KEY_SERVICE > RW_API_KEY_ORG > REDWOOD_API_KEY. Add a startup diagnostic log line (masked) e.g. `auth.selected=RW_API_KEY_PROJECT (****3123)` so users can see which key is in effect.

devon: add a one-time WARN if REDWOOD_API_KEY and any RW_API_KEY_* are both present. CLI warns at init but libs should be defensive. Also add telemetry ping (anonymized) sdk.auth.conflict_detected so we can measure impact; opt-out via RW_AUTH_TELEMETRY=false.

sam: for streams I'll prototype TokenRefreshHandler and add a sampleapp example showing graceful reconnect flow. We'll gate auto-refresh behind RW_ENABLE_TOKEN_REFRESH=true.

cli-bot: created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/1742 "sdk: env precedence + stream refresh on rotation"

docs-bot: docs stub created at https://docs.redwood.ai/sdk/auth#env-precedence with migration notes.

noah: action items: anya open PR to restore precedence + diag + warn; devon add e2e for rotating keys during an active stream; sam prototype refresh handler and sampleapp patch; i'll update onboarding quickstart to recommend unsetting REDWOOD_API_KEY when using project keys.

anya: plan to include compatibility flag RW_LEGACY_KEY_COMPAT=true for one release and a small deprecation note. Keep changes minimal and ship the WARN ASAP.

devon: will follow up with PR and tests later today.

noah: thanks all 64f. Closing thread until we see further regressions.
